rfp_requirements.title: Provide Facility Management
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide Facility Management.

rfp_requirements.title: Observe facility regulations and security protocols
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor personnel must observe all regulations in effect at each CIF, including any security protocols and sign-in/sign-out procedures.

rfp_requirements.title: No facility entry until requirements satisfied
rfp_requirements.description: No Contractor personnel shall be permitted to enter any facility until these requirements are satisfied.

rfp_requirements.title: All existing facilities remain State property including repairs/modifications
Perform repairs to shared co-located areas when requested
Conduct single-lane facility maintenance outside posted hours
Utilize MVC/DEP-approved equipment
Establish preventive maintenance program per OEM standards
Ensure availability of sufficient spare parts
Provide bill of sale/proof of ownership for purchased equipment
Steam Extract Carpets
rfp_requirements.description: Clean carpets via steam extraction when visibly dirty or at minimum twice per year.

rfp_requirements.title: Use HEPA Filter Vacuum
rfp_requirements.description: Perform all vacuuming with a vacuum cleaner containing a HEPA2 filter.

rfp_requirements.title: Monthly Rough Lawn Mowing
rfp_requirements.description: Mow rough lawn areas (drainage ditches, catch basins, wood lot, transitions) monthly.

rfp_requirements.title: Pay Alarm Service Fees
rfp_requirements.description: Be solely responsible for timely payment and performance of all fees, maintenance and upgrades associated with alarm services.

rfp_requirements.title: Responsible for Utility Fees
rfp_requirements.description: Be responsible for all utility fees as specified in Appendix 3.2G.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide routine service and maintenance at Contractor's expense
Provide maintenance to CIFs and four SIFs
Document DEP guidance and secure SCM approval for supplies
Vacuum carpets daily and steam-clean at minimum twice yearly
Install Energy Efficient Lighting/Appliances
rfp_requirements.description: When replacement is needed, install and use lighting, machinery and appliances that meet the highest energy efficiency requirements pursuant to EO 54 and N.J.S.A. 52:34-6.4.

rfp_requirements.title: Coordinate Initial Facility Assessment
rfp_requirements.description: Coordinate and schedule each initial facility assessment visit and identify necessary or anticipated Work in cooperation with the State.

rfp_requirements.title: State Right to Negotiate Cost/SOW and Award PO to Others
rfp_requirements.description: Acknowledge that during any NJ State fiscal year, the State reserves the right to negotiate cost and SOW with the Contractor, secure additional competitive quotes, and award a purchase order to any contractor of its choosing for maintenance, repair, renovation or construction work; the cost of such

rfp_requirements.title: Secure SCM Approval Before Beginning Work
rfp_requirements.description: Secure written SCM approval for all capital repairs, maintenance, and/or renovation requests before beginning work.

rfp_requirements.title: Include Standardized Procedures in Plan
rfp_requirements.description: Plan shall include standardized procedures for performing preventive maintenance, structural repair/replacement, and property repair/replacement within 180 calendar days of Contract Effective Date.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit SOW and Quotes to SCM
rfp_requirements.description: Present SOW along with all conforming competitive quotes to the SCM for review and approval prior to initiating any related work.

rfp_requirements.title: Reference Appendix 3.2G for Historical Capital Expenditures
rfp_requirements.description: Appendix 3.2G provides the State's historical expenditures for capital renovations, maintenance, and repairs for FY 2009 through 2023 and as estimated for 2024; Contractor must use this as reference for planning.

rfp_requirements.title: Secure SCM Approval for Plan Updates
rfp_requirements.description: Secure written SCM approval for each update submitted to its CIF Capital Project Plan.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain Facilities in Mutually Agreed Condition
rfp_requirements.description: Maintain each facility within the mutually agreed operating condition and perform all approved work.

rfp_requirements.title: HVAC Maintained per PEOSH
rfp_requirements.description: All HVAC systems must be maintained in accordance with Public Employees Occupational Safety and Health (PEOSH) regulations.

rfp_requirements.title: Obtain SCM Approval Before Alterations
rfp_requirements.description: Obtain SCM approval prior to making any alterations, unless required for emergency repairs.

rfp_requirements.title: Adequate Non-Excessive Lighting Levels
rfp_requirements.description: Lighting levels must be adequate for the intended purpose but not excessive.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain MVC Shared Facilities
rfp_requirements.description: Maintain and repair all buildings or sections of buildings in which Contractor provides services, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing water and waste systems.

rfp_requirements.title: Perform MVC Shared Area Repairs at No Charge
rfp_requirements.description: When requested by SCM, perform repairs to shared areas within State-owned MVC buildings at no additional charge.

rfp_requirements.title: Secure at least three independent quotes for remediation
Secure written SCM approval to remove/dispose of State property
Provide performance and capacity details for all server configurations
Provide PIF/ERF Facility Locations Map Linked from MVC
rfp_requirements.description: Provide a map of all active PIF/ERF facility locations throughout the State which must be linked from the MVC website.

rfp_requirements.title: Fully update annual master inventory list
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall, in mutual agreement with the State, fully update an annual master inventory list for each facility.

rfp_requirements.title: Ship only contract-covered items
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor is authorized to ship only those items covered by the resulting contract; delivery of non-contract items is a violation and may be grounds for termination.

rfp_requirements.title: Account for Historical Facility Renovations, Maintenance and Repairs Expenditures
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor should be aware of historical Facility Renovations, Maintenance and Repairs expenditures (items such as carpentry, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, parking lot lighting, locksmithing, painting, roofing, parking lot/sidewalk/driveway/curbing/paving repairs, lane floor repairs, and erosion contr

rfp_requirements.title: Negotiate and Fund Rental of Randolph Service Core Trailer
rfp_requirements.description: The Randolph Service Core is a trailer leased by the current contractor at approximately $300 per month; the new contractor will need to negotiate and pay for monthly rent with the owner or acquire another trailer (funding rental or purchase plus hookup costs).

rfp_requirements.title: Prohibition on discharging Employee for non-membership under specified conditions
rfp_requirements.description: The Employer shall not discharge any Employee for non-membership in the Union if (a) it has reasonable grounds for believing membership was not available on the same terms generally applicable to other members, or (b) membership was denied or terminated for reasons other than failure to tender perio

rfp_requirements.title: Offer displaced employees vacant positions statewide
rfp_requirements.description: Displaced employees unable to bump within the same classification/location may be offered a vacant Associate Lane Technician position at another facility by statewide seniority or elect layoff; Equipment Repair Technicians may displace junior ERTs by statewide seniority.

rfp_requirements.title: Ensure roller assemblies are tightened before using jack
rfp_requirements.description: For flat rollers, the installer must ensure roller assemblies are tightened before using the jack, after installed in the rail, so wheels sit about ¼" below the bottom of the wheel tube.

rfp_requirements.title: Tighten hex bolts to lock side members in place
rfp_requirements.description: Once side members are adjusted and jack is centered between rails, tighten the four hex bolts (2 per side) to lock in place.

rfp_requirements.title: State Treasurer exercises authority of Division of Purchase and Property and Division of Building and Construction Directors
rfp_requirements.description: The State Treasurer is authorized to exercise all authority of the Directors of the Division of Purchase and Property and of the Division of Building and Construction to award the contract(s) as a single contract, multiple branch contracts, or multiple single contracts.

Parsons Transportation Group Inc. (Parsons) is pleased to provide this proposal to the Pennsylvania Department of
Transportation (PennDOT), Bureau of Office Services, in response to Request for Proposal (RFP) Number 3522R12
for Emissions Program Management.
Our commitment to PennDOT is to continue delivering an effective Pennsylvania Vehicle Emissions Inspection and
Maintenance Program and to innovate responsibly to move the Program forward. Building on our past performance,
we will implement new, cloud-based VIID systems and improved auditing infrastructure that efficiently gets Program
data to PennDOT. Our upgrades to the e-SAFETY system will support the enhanced safety inspection Program
compliance. We will upgrade our call center solution with new technology using ZenDesk and AmazonConnect as
the backbone of the system.

I-1. STATEMENT OF THE PROJECT
Pennsylvania operates one of the largest, longest-running decentralized Vehicle Emissions Inspection and Maintenance
(I/M) Programs in the United States. The Commonwealth’s I/M Program, divided into four regions, has grown to around
8,200 stations throughout 25 counties since 1997. PennDOT estimates nearly 7 million vehicles will be subject to
inspection by 2025. The Program design provides consumer convenience, supports private inspection stations, and
improves air quality. Stations in the Program are responsible for maintaining inspection equipment appropriate for the
required inspection types in the given region.
PennDOT is seeking a reliable, experienced Offeror to provide Emissions Program Management and continue the
successful operations of the I/M Program, overseeing safety inspection stations and related systems to keep consumer
and inspection station costs as low as possible while maintaining vehicle and consumer safety. The Program must
comply with federal and state requirements while providing adaptability for future Progr
